topics.name: Lock and Unlock
topics.purpose: Define unlocked/locked as validation lifecycle states: migration starts unlocked, contracts become locked only after current evidence proves Contract Format 1.4 conformance, and affected locks reopen when semantics or evidence change.

semantics.lock_rule: locked means current applicable validation, closure, completeness, evidence and ownership checks pass.
semantics.unlocked_rule: unlocked means the target is under migration/review/change or has unresolved required gaps.
semantics.change_rule: Semantic change invalidating lock evidence reopens affected targets to unlocked.
semantics.dependency_rule: A locked consumer cannot rely on unresolved required dependencies while still claiming full lock eligibility.
semantics.evidence_rule: Lock state carries current machine-readable evidence refs.
semantics.repository_rule: Repository-wide locked status requires all mandatory active graph surfaces to be lock-eligible.

invariants.rule: Repository activation, migration state, validation state and replacement decisions are explicit and machine-readable.

hard_gates.condition: target locked without current validation evidence
semantic change leaves stale locked state
migration target defaults locked before validation
required unresolved dependency ignored by lock evaluation
repository declared locked while mandatory active surface remains unlocked/incomplete
